items.excerpt: Foundry released an AI-powered SmartRoto add-on for Nuke that automatically propagates and deforms roto splines across a shot, claiming to speed up rotoscoping 'up to 4x' versus manual work.

Chaos shipped V-Ray 7.4 for Blender, adding a Quick Sun Caustics system, UDIM support, Cycles-to-V-Ray lighting conversion, and tighter integration with Veras, its architectural AI rendering software.

Meshy's new conversational 3D Agent keeps context across a session so creators can set art direction and generate stylistically consistent, production-ready 3D assets, positioning AI as a creative partner rather than a one-shot prompt.

Albert Omoss released ArcBrush 1.5, a $49 node-based image editor for VFX and motion graphics that adds a 32-bit pipeline, Cryptomatte support, and cloud-based AI upscaling and background-removal features.
